Alok Kanojia also known as Dr K is a twitch streamer and internet personality

Before starting his online career he was a psychiatrist and former Buddhist monk

He is a particularly good [[Meditation (general practice)|meditation]] teacher due to having been in countless different monasteries of different traditions. Not an expert in any individual type, but gives a good survey of all types
